name: ModelVariant819_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant819_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (four bolts drop from a model point at their own start times onto a jittered point beside the opposing slot, wrapped in a ring of sprite crosses and spinning Gouraud strips and trailing a ribbon and smoke puffs that fades once its bolt lands; on landing each flares into a glow, sprays falling debris and shards, plays an animated flash and grows a sixteen-segment shock ring while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolts, debris and shock rings and packs seven texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the first start time, 4 once as each of the first three bolts lands, 1 once when the last bolt lands, 2 once the last glow has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-836 and 933 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
